verses.translation: For the end, a Psalm for Asaph, concerning the wine-presses.

translations.ron: Bucuraţi-vă de Dumnezeu, ajutorul nostru; strigaţi Dumnezeului lui Iacob!
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ὑπὲρ τῶν ληνῶν ψαλμὸς τῷ Ἀσάφ.

verses.translation: Rejoice ye in God our helper; shout aloud to the God of Jacob.

translations.ron: Cântaţi psalmi şi bateţi din timpane; cântaţi dulce din psaltire şi din alăută!
translations.grk: Ἀγαλλιᾶσθε τῷ Θεῷ τῷ βοηθῷ ἡμῶν, ἀλαλάξατε τῷ Θεῷ Ἰακώβ.

verses.translation: Take a psalm, and produce the timbrel, the pleasant psaltery with the harp.

translations.ron: Sunaţi din trâmbiţă, la lună nouă, în ziua cea binevestită a sărbătorii noastre!
translations.grk: Λάβετε ψαλμὸν καὶ δότε τύμπανον, ψαλτήριον τερπνὸν μετὰ κιθάρας.

verses.translation: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, in the glorious day of your feast.

translations.ron: Că poruncă pentru Israel este şi orânduire a Dumnezeului lui Iacob. Mărturie a pus în Iosif, când a ieşit din pământul Egiptului, şi a auzit limba pe care n-o ştia:
translations.grk: Σαλπίσατε ἐν νεομηνίᾳ σάλπιγγι, ἐν εὐσήμῳ ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς ὑμῶν.

verses.translation: For this is an ordinance for Israel, and a statute of the God of Jacob.

translations.ron: "Luat-am sarcina de pe umerii lui, că mâinile lui au robit la coşuri.
translations.grk: Ὅτι πρόσταγμα τῷ Ἰσραήλ ἐστι, καὶ κρίμα τῷ Θεῷ Ἰακώβ.

verses.translation: He made it to be a testimony in Joseph, when he came forth out of the land of Egypt: he heard a language which he understood not.

translations.ron: Întru necaz M-ai chemat şi te-am izbăvit, te-am auzit în mijlocul furtunii şi te-am cercat la apa certării.
translations.grk: Μαρτύριον ἐν τῷ Ἰωσὴφ ἔθετο αὐτὸν, ἐν τῷ ἐξελθεῖν αὐτὸν ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου· γλῶσσαν ἣν οὐκ ἔγνω, ἤκουσεν.

verses.translation: He removed his back from burdens: his hands slaved in making the baskets.

translations.ron: Ascultă, poporul Meu, şi-ţi voi mărturisi ţie, Israele: De Mă vei asculta pe Mine,
translations.grk: Ἀπέστησεν ἀπὸ ἄρσεων τὸν νῶτον αὐτοῦ· αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κοφίνῳ ἐδούλευσαν.

verses.translation: Thou didst call upon me in trouble, and I delivered thee; I heard thee in the secret place of the storm: I proved thee at the water of Strife. Pause.

translations.ron: Nu vei avea alt Dumnezeu, nici nu te vei închina la dumnezeu străin,
translations.grk: Ἐν θλίψει ἐπεκαλέσω με καὶ ἐῤῥυσάμην σε· ἐπήκουσά σου ἐν ἀποκρύφῳ καταιγίδος, ἐδοκίμασά σε ἐπὶ ὕδατος ἀντιλογίας· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: Hear, my people, and I will speak to thee, O Israel; and I will testify to thee: if thou wilt hearken to me;

translations.ron: Că Eu sunt Domnul Dumnezeul tău, Cel ce te-am scos din pământul Egiptului. Deschide gura şi o voi umple pe ea.
translations.grk: Ἄκουσον λαός μου καὶ λαλήσω σοι, Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ διαμαρτύρομαί σοι· ἐὰν ἀκούσῃς μου,

verses.translation: there shall be no new god in thee; neither shalt thou worship a strange god.

translations.ron: Dar na ascultat poporul Meu glasul Meu şi Israel n-a căutat la Mine.
translations.grk: οὐκ ἔσται ἐν σοὶ θεὸς πρόσφατος, οὐδὲ προσκυνήσεις θεῷ ἀλλοτρίῳ.

verses.translation: For I am the Lord thy God, that brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

translations.ron: Şi i-am lăsat să umble după dorinţele inimilor lor şi au mers după cugetele lor.
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου, ὁ ἀναγαγών σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, πλάτυνον τὸ στόμα σου καὶ πληρώσω αὐτό.

verses.translation: But my people hearkened not to my voice; and Israel gave no heed to me.

translations.ron: De M-ar fi ascultat poporul Meu, de ar fi umblat Israel în căile Mele,
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσεν ὁ λαός μου τῆς φωνῆς μου, καὶ Ἰσραὴλ οὐ προσέσχε μοι.

verses.translation: So I let them go after the ways of their own hearts: they will go on in their own ways.

translations.ron: I-aş fi supus de tot pe vrăjmaşii lor şi aş fi pus mâna Mea pe asupritorii lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξαπέστειλα αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα τῶν καρδιῶν αὐτῶν, πορεύσονται ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: If my people had hearkened to me, if Israel had walked in my ways,

translations.ron: Vrăjmaşii Domnului L-au minţit pe El, dar le va veni timpul lor, în veac.
translations.grk: Εἰ ὁ λαός μου ἤκουσέ μου, Ἰσραὴλ ταῖς ὁδοῖς μου εἰ ἐπορεύθη,

verses.translation: I should have put down their enemies very quickly, and should have laid my hand upon those that afflicted them.

translations.ron: Că Domnul i-a hrănit pe ei din griul cel mai ales şi cu miere din stâncă i-a săturat pe ei".
translations.grk: ἐν τῷ μηδενὶ ἂν τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτῶν ἐταπείνωσα, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θλίβοντας αὐτοὺς ἐπέβαλον ἂν τὴν χεῖρά μου.

verses.translation: The Lord's enemies should have lied to him: but their time shall be for ever.

translations.grk: Οἱ ἐχθροὶ Κυρίου ἐψεύσαντο αὐτῷ, καὶ ἔσται ὁ καιρὸς αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα,

verses.translation: And he fed them with the fat of wheat; and satisfied them with honey out of the rock.

translations.grk: καὶ ἐψώμισεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ στέατος πυροῦ, καὶ ἐκ πέτρας μέλι ἐχόρτασεν αὐτούς.
